The Files app is open and currently displaying the Downloads folder, which is empty. To access the "sdk_gphone_x86_64" storage area and locate the "project_easy" folder, I need to navigate to the root of the filesystem. The "Show roots" button (hamburger icon) at [0, 53, 135, 105] will allow me to access the directory tree and select the desired storage area.
